name: loop-breaker
title: Loop Breaker
blurb: Notices when the agent keeps running the same failing command or flips an edit back and forth, refuses the next identical try, and shows a stuck meter above the prompt. A real code change or a different error resets it, so normal fix-and-retest work is never blocked.

name: assertion-guardian
title: Assertion Guardian
blurb: Refuses edits that weaken tests to fake a green run: changed expected values, looser matchers, deleted assertions, `.skip`/`.only`, swallowed failures, bulk snapshot updates. You can allow a specific change once.

name: secret-sentry
title: Secret Sentry
blurb: Redacts credentials in prompts and tool output before the model sees them, and refuses writes or shell commands that would put a key into a tracked file.

name: dependency-bouncer
title: Dependency Bouncer
blurb: Checks packages against the npm and PyPI registries before they install. It blocks made-up names, typosquats and brand-new packages with install scripts, and flags dependencies you already have something for.

name: quarantine
title: Quarantine
blurb: Wraps untrusted tool output (web pages, MCP results, vendored files, fetched PR and issue text) in an "untrusted content" fence and defangs lines that read like instructions, so prompt injections arrive as data.

name: budget-governor
title: Budget Governor
blurb: Enforces session and daily spend caps. It shows a gauge above the prompt, tells the model to wrap up at 80%, and refuses new prompts at the cap until you raise it.

name: red-squiggle
title: Red Squiggle
blurb: Runs your project's own tsc, eslint and ruff right after each edit and attaches only the new errors to that edit's result, so the model fixes them on the same step.

name: proof-decay
title: Proof Decay
blurb: Tracks whether "tests passed" is still true. Later edits turn results stale on a board above the prompt, and Oathkeeper refuses commit messages that claim checks pass when they aren't current.

name: review-ghost
title: Review Ghost
blurb: When the agent reads or edits a file on a branch with an open PR, it attaches that file's unresolved GitHub review threads. `/ghost` lists them all.

name: redbox-relay
title: Redbox Relay
blurb: For React Native: attaches fresh simulator and emulator errors to your next prompt, and warns when an edit to native code needs `pod install` and a native rebuild.

name: mirror-pane
title: Mirror Pane
blurb: After a UI edit, captures the simulator or emulator screen before and after hot reload and shows them side by side in a pane, with the percentage of pixels that changed. It never guesses between booted devices.

name: inline-tribunal
title: Inline Tribunal
blurb: A `second_opinion` tool and a `/tribunal` command that send your diff to Codex and Grok in locked-down, read-only sandboxes and show both verdicts side by side.

name: stack-traffic-control
title: Stack Traffic Control
blurb: A departure board for `gh stack` stacked PRs (`/stack`), plus a guard that refuses force-pushes, rebases and PR base changes on stacked branches and points to the right `gh stack` command.

name: process-concierge
title: Process Concierge
blurb: Every dev server, watcher and background build the agent starts gets an owner, a port and a stop button (`/procs`). It stops duplicate servers on a busy port, and only ever stops processes it can prove the agent started.

name: netrunner-hud
title: Netrunner HUD
blurb: `/hud` opens a cyberpunk dashboard at 30fps: a radial context gauge, a token-rate oscilloscope, a tool-call waterfall, and live process, git and test widgets.

name: codebase-galaxy
title: Codebase Galaxy
blurb: `/galaxy` draws your repo as a braille starfield: files are stars, imports are faint edges, and Claude's attention is a comet with a fading trail. Pan, zoom and click stars.

name: netrunner-trace
title: Netrunner Trace
blurb: Every outbound action (curl, gh, npm, git push, WebFetch, MCP) flies as a packet from your machine to a ring of hosts. First-contact hosts flash amber and unexpected ones glow red, so you get a real security view.

name: boot-sequence
title: Boot Sequence
blurb: A BIOS-style POST screen when a session starts that runs real checks (git, toolchains, simulators, dev-server ports, disk, context) and types each one out as `[ OK ]`, `[WARN]` or `[FAIL]`. `/boot` replays it.

name: diff-seismograph
title: Diff Seismograph
blurb: A live braille seismograph of lines added and removed above the prompt, with `QUAKE M5.2` alerts on big edits. `/quake` adds a heat treemap of the repo, glowing where this session changed code.

name: departure-board
title: Departure Board
blurb: A Solari split-flap board in amber that cascades flap by flap as Claude's tasks go from BOARDING to DEPARTED, DELAYED or CANCELLED. A mini board sits above the prompt and `/board` opens it fullscreen.

name: transit-map
title: Transit Map
blurb: `/metro` shows your git history as a Vignelli subway map: branches are coloured lines, commits are stations, merges are interchanges, and your working tree is a train with one car per uncommitted file.

name: fault-lacquer
title: Fault Lacquer
blurb: Kintsugi for your session: each failing operation cracks its lacquer tile, and when it later succeeds the cracks fill with animated gold seams. `/kintsugi` shows the wall.

name: context-dungeon
title: Context Dungeon
blurb: A roguelike pane driven by your real session: context is HP, failing tests spawn monsters named after the error, green runs land the killing blow, and commits open treasure chests.

name: speedrun-splits
title: Speedrun Splits
blurb: A LiveSplit-style timer above the prompt. It splits automatically from recon to first edit to test to green to commit or PR, and keeps personal bests and gold segments for each repo.
